name: Ross NK Router

actions.name: Route Crosspoint
actions.description: Route a Source to a Destination

options.label: Level
options.description: minSelection 1 (not representable in the catalog). Ids are strings; the callback adds the selected values together into a bit mask (1-255) and the module logs an error and sends nothing if the sum is 0.

options.label: Input
options.choicesNote: Ids are the strings "1".."N" with N = config option "inputs" (min 1, max 512, default 16), built in src/api.ts UpdateOptions() (src/api.ts:18-24); labels are the same numbers.

options.label: Output
options.choicesNote: Ids are the strings "1".."N" with N = config option "outputs" (min 1, max 512, default 16), built in src/api.ts UpdateOptions() (src/api.ts:18-24); labels are the same numbers.

notes: Complete list: one action (routerXPT, src/actions.ts) and no feedbacks. src/feedbacks.ts registers an empty definition set; src/presets.ts and src/variables.ts are empty as well.

Protocol: binary NK-NET packets over TCP to the NK-NET adapter (config option "Port (default 5000)", default 5000, plus the T-Bus address of the router, default 1; src/api.ts ChangeXPT()). Received data is only logged (verbose option) and triggers checkFeedbacks(); there is no state parsing. After connecting it sends PHOENIX-DB N and a HI keep-alive every 10 seconds.
Input and output are 1-based in the options and converted to 0-based in the packet; the module logs an error and sends nothing when input or output exceed the configured counts (src/api.ts:92-117).
Option lists depend on the config options "inputs" and "outputs" (rebuilt in init and configUpdated), so they are not enumerated.
The manifest repository points to josephdadams/companion-module-rossvideo-nkrouter; the catalog uses the bitfocus repository of the index.
Built on @companion-module/base ^1.12.1: options do not support expressions.
